gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese keeps its e crossbars open and its capitals nearly level with the lowercase, a quiet foil for Neon. Paragraphs run smooth and clean, with no fuss.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-takri: Glow meets restraint: Neon burns with constant-width lines while Noto Sans Takri opens every small round letter and lifts its lowercase high. Extended reading stays smooth and businesslike, never tiring the eye.

gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-tc: Neon draws diagonals that match its stems, glowing in one unbroken line width. Noto Sans TC brings large open counters and outward-opening curves, so paragraphs read friendly and smooth.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-thai: Glowing, Neon lets its horizontals hold their own against the verticals, never thinning. Noto Sans Thai then sets swollen, bead-like lowercase with rounded letters left open, giving the glow a gentler partner.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Monoline glow from Neon up top, stem to serif without a change. Below, Noto Sans Warang Citi forms words as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-traditional-nush: Pipe-like strokes glow in Neon while Noto Traditional Nushu writes with a broad nib that never curls shut. Its bowls fill the line, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-numans: Flat glow meets coiled rope: Neon keeps its stroke weight unmodulated while Numans swells its lowercase and spaces it far apart. Hanging s ends add a loose, modern swing between the two.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans keeps one stroke thickness everywhere, with lowercase rising near capitals. Beneath the glow of Neon, Parkinsans stays crisp, its wide-mouthed letters holding up well when shrunk, a sturdy counterpart to all that shine.
